calls.name: authority.inspect
calls.contract: Current granted identity/policy and an appropriate fence (ControlFence only for an owner); no persistent business mutation.

calls.name: control.configure
calls.contract: Owner control route only; record/policy version compare-and-set.

calls.name: memory.remember
calls.parameters: scope, content, source, expected_revision?, fence: ScopeFence, idempotency_key
calls.contract: Create or supersede Memory atomically; expected_revision required for replacement; return memory_id and record_revision.

calls.name: memory.recall
calls.contract: Only permitted CURRENT records with provenance.

calls.name: memory.read
calls.contract: Authorized record, including authorized historical views.

calls.name: memory.forget
calls.contract: Reversible tombstone; never unrestricted permanent erasure.

calls.name: task.create
calls.parameters: objective, acceptance_criteria, scope, fence: ScopeFence, idempotency_key
calls.contract: Create ACCEPTED Task and durable admission intent.

calls.name: task.read
calls.contract: Current authorized Task state.

calls.name: task.steer
calls.parameters: task_id, expected_revision, requested_change, fence: RecordFence, idempotency_key
calls.contract: Validate owner change, increment task_revision and fence old execution.

calls.name: task.cancel
calls.contract: Record CANCEL_REQUESTED and reconcile; no effect rollback claim.

calls.name: task.review
calls.parameters: task_id, expected_revision, review_outcome, fence: RecordFence, idempotency_key
calls.contract: Authorized reviewer follows matrix, never the proposing worker.

calls.name: task.transition
calls.parameters: task_id, expected_revision, payload, fence: RecordFence, idempotency_key
calls.contract: Internal scheduler/monitor only; matrix actor/guard required, including lease expiry.

calls.name: executor.claim
calls.contract: Atomic claim of eligible Task; returns Assignment, current task_revision and fence_token: ExecutionFence.

calls.name: executor.heartbeat
calls.contract: Renew only a current, unexpired lease under policy.

calls.name: executor.checkpoint
calls.parameters: assignment_id, expected_task_revision, checkpoint, fence: ExecutionFence, idempotency_key
calls.contract: Accept only current revision/generation evidence.

calls.name: executor.report
calls.parameters: assignment_id, expected_task_revision, report, fence: ExecutionFence, idempotency_key
calls.contract: Record current progress; submission is not owner acceptance.

calls.name: context.build
calls.contract: Current authority first, selected permitted evidence next.

calls.name: budget.reserve
calls.contract: Internal budget authority atomically reserves combined ledger capacity.

calls.name: budget.reconcile
calls.contract: Internal budget authority accounts for delayed/uncertain usage.

calls.name: artifact.commit
calls.contract: Check generation-specific upload digest and authorized retention before accepting reference.

calls.name: recovery.restore
calls.contract: Operator-only inactive restore, fresh epoch and revoked old authority; later entity types remain gate-restricted.

calls.name: operation.propose
calls.parameters: task_id, expected_revision, operation_descriptor, fence: ExecutionFence, idempotency_key
calls.contract: Trusted Task owner mints operation_id on first successful admission; proposal cannot dispatch.

calls.name: operation.dispatch
calls.parameters: operation_id, fence: RecordFence, execution_fence: ExecutionFence, idempotency_key
calls.contract: Internal broker only; its own RecordFence authorizes the actor, and execution_fence proves the current Assignment binding; recheck Task, operation revision, approval and policy.

calls.name: operation.recordOutcome
calls.contract: Internal broker only; current-epoch receipt recording after dispatch, including UNKNOWN.

calls.name: operation.reconcile
calls.contract: Internal reconciler may query remote status and record evidence; cannot initiate a new remote write.

calls.name: approval.create
calls.contract: Internal broker only; create PENDING exact-intent Approval, never self-approve.

calls.name: approval.decide
calls.contract: Trusted owner route/callback resolves fence server-side after verified binding; model cannot call it.

calls.name: approval.invalidate
calls.contract: Internal service expires/revokes under current policy; cannot approve.

calls.name: event.ingest
calls.contract: Verified source adapter only; source_event_id deduplication also required.

fields.principal_id: Verified internal principal identifier; never a caller-selected impersonation.
fields.principal_kind: PrincipalKind enum; separates owner, client/bot, executor, webhook and service.
fields.issuer, subject: Verified external identity issuer and subject pair; optional for deployment-bound internal identities.
fields.credential_version: Revocation/rotation version checked against the authority registry.
fields.enabled: Boolean registration/grant switch; false denies use.
fields.workspace_id: Permission-domain identifier looked up in the authoritative workspace catalog.
fields.actions: Explicit allowlist of application call/capability names; absence denies.
fields.resource_selectors: Server-reviewed constraints on resources within a workspace.
fields.policy_version: Current authorization configuration revision; a changed version invalidates affected fences.
fields.executor_id: Registered executor identifier mapped to exactly its verified principal.
fields.permitted_classifications: Subset of Classification allowed by executor registration and policy; EXCLUDED_SENSITIVE never enabled in MVP.
fields.capability_set, required_capabilities: Registered/declared capability names and the Assignment-required subset; claim uses their authorized intersection.
fields.subject_ref: Scoped subject the learned fact concerns; optional.
fields.content_or_ref: Inline permitted content or authorized immutable artifact reference, never executable policy.
fields.source_ref, source: Provenance reference or registered source name; cannot grant trust or scope.
fields.producer_ref, actor_ref, owner_ref: References to verified producer, observed actor or enrolled human owner; an observed actor is not an authenticated caller.
fields.schema_version: Explicit record/interface schema version; incompatible versions rejected.
fields.record_revision: Compare-and-set revision of a non-Task record, including grant and ledger records.
fields.observed_at, received_at: Observation time and server ingestion time, respectively.
fields.valid_from, valid_until: Optional evidence validity interval; not credential or approval validity.
fields.trust_class: TrustClass enum describing provenance authority; independent from classification.
fields.status: Closed lifecycle enum for the containing entity, defined below.
fields.supersedes_ref: Optional version-bound reference (memory_id plus record_revision) to the earlier Memory replaced by a new CURRENT record.
fields.task_id: Server-owned Task identity; distinct from native conversation/session identity.
fields.objective, acceptance_criteria: Accepted goal and review conditions controlled by the current task_revision.
fields.task_revision: Accepted objective/scope/criteria revision; increments on authorized steering.
fields.authority_epoch: Fresh recovery/authorization incarnation; comparisons across epochs are invalid.
fields.generation: Execution-ownership counter inside an epoch; increments when ownership is invalidated/transferred.
fields.mandate_ref: Versioned authorized task scope and constraints; cannot broaden WorkspaceGrant.
fields.assignment_ref, assignment_id: Current Assignment reference and its server-owned identity.
fields.budget_ref: Shared BudgetReservation/ledger reference; not independent per-task budget authority.
fields.evidence_refs: Permitted supporting artifact, observation and receipt references.
fields.lease_expires_at: Server lease deadline; no authority after expiry even with a live connection.
fields.deadline: Task/Assignment completion deadline under owner policy; no value invented here.
fields.context_ref: Authorized context snapshot reference recording task and source revisions.
fields.checkpoint_ref: Durable accepted checkpoint reference; optional until first checkpoint.
fields.reserved_estimate, actual_usage, uncerta: Reserved cost estimate, reconciled usage and possibly incurred usage in the ledger; calibrated policy supplies ceilings.
fields.artifact_id, object_ref: Server Artifact ID and generation-specific retained object locator.
fields.digest: SHA-256 of exact retained bytes, checked on upload/read/restore.
fields.mime_type, size: Declared content media type and byte size, checked against content.
fields.retention_ref: Owner-approved retention rule reference; unset blocks retained-data reliance.
fields.operation_id: Stable logical effect ID minted by the trusted Task owner during first proposal admission.
fields.capability, resource: Allowlisted typed effect and constrained destination resource.
fields.arguments_ref, arguments_hash: Immutable effect arguments/reference and digest of their canonical content.
fields.preconditions: Typed expected destination/task conditions checked before dispatch.
fields.approval_ref, approval_id: Reference to the single Approval record and its server-owned ID.
fields.remote_key, remote_receipt: Provider idempotency key and redacted outcome/query receipt; absence is not evidence of no effect.
fields.descriptor_hash: Digest binding operation ID, workspace/task/revision, capability, target, arguments, preconditions, risk and approval expiry.
fields.issued_at, expires_at: Server issuance/expiration of Approval or credential; validity checked at use.
fields.channel_binding: Verified owner and private-channel binding, including Telegram numeric from.id and chat.id when applicable.
fields.decision_receipt: Authenticated decision, decision time and delivery dedupe evidence; no callback secret.
fields.event_id, source_event_id: Server observation identity and source-scoped delivery dedupe key.
fields.thread_refs: Source conversation/thread references for deterministic routing; no access grant.
fields.kind: Registered event schema discriminator; source adapters define payload, not authority.
fields.idempotency_key: Caller-minted stable logical request key under the namespace and payload rules below.
fields.fence: Server-issued MutationFence authorizing the verified caller at every mutating call.
fields.expected_revision: Requested compare-and-set revision; must equal authoritative record and fence binding.
fields.expected_task_revision: Task revision guard; must match both Task and ExecutionFence.
fields.scope: Requested workspace plus resource restriction, intersected with verified grants.
fields.content: Memory input carrying content_or_ref, classification, trust_class and optional subject_ref/valid_from/valid_until/supersedes_ref; immutable canonical request content for dedupe.
fields.query, limit: Authorized recall expression and bounded result limit, subject to configured policy.
fields.role: Requested executor role; cannot enlarge registration.
fields.checkpoint: Generation-specific durable recovery evidence with references/digests.
fields.report: Structured progress/result/evidence submission; never directly marks Task COMPLETED.
fields.operation_descriptor: Immutable typed Operation intent as defined above.
fields.requested_change: Owner-authorized requested objective/scope/criteria change; validated before revision update.
fields.review_outcome: ReviewOutcome enum; criteria acceptance, rework or changed requirements.
fields.reason: Closed fence-error reason, or typed audited transition justification; not executable instructions.
fields.payload: Validated typed data for the named internal transition; cannot select a different actor.
fields.restore_manifest: Authorized schema/scope/revision/receipt/artifact manifest for inactive recovery.
fields.config_change: Reviewed control-plane registration/grant/credential/kill-switch change; secrets supplied separately through trusted channels.
fields.call_name: Exact application interface name, part of an idempotency namespace.
fields.token_budget: Requested context size bound; subject to policy and current reservation.
fields.fence_token: Opaque authenticated ExecutionFence handle returned by executor.claim; never synthesized from public IDs.
fields.guard_ref: Guard profile used by the Task transition matrix; not a caller-selectable bypass.
fields.choice: ApprovalChoice enum in the verified owner decision payload; not agent-supplied authority.
fields.code: ErrorCode enum identifying a rejected request; no hidden authorization detail.
fields.message: Safe explanatory error text without secrets or unauthorized object metadata.
fields.retryable: Boolean indicating whether ordinary automatic retry is appropriate; false for STALE_FENCE.
fields.recovery: RecoveryAction enum describing the next authorized recovery step, never permission for a new write.
fields.execution_fence: Additional current Assignment ExecutionFence checked by the broker during dispatch; binds the enrolled executor, not the broker service identity.
